title: First-query expectation and the constant Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta\in[0,1]$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. Choose independently at each coordinate a sign triple by selecting the pair construction with probability $\delta$ and the parity construction otherwise, where these constructions are $(U,V,-V)$ and $(U,V,-UV)$ for independent uniform signs $U,V$. The expectation of $f$ evaluated on the first query vector is the uniform average of $f$ on $\{-1,1\}^n$, equivalently its Fourier coefficient at the empty set.
